messages:
marta: quick follow-up from postmortem — action items andownership for missing spans / bad aggregation / ETL lag. small cadence: daily check-ins until close.

raj: I can own sampler drift remediation. plan: pin sampler in helm values, add admission check, and add CI test to catch drift. ETA: PR by Tuesday.

emily: I'll take aggregator fixes. adding invariant checks, a reconciliation job, and a small canary. ETA: end of week.

vincent: ETL lag lead here. immediate: increase consumer parallelism and add backpressure metrics. longer: partition rebalance and consumer balancing. mitigation deployed now.

oncall-bot: Runbook snapshot saved at 2423456900. link: https://runbooks.internal/obs-missing-spans

marta: please create tickets on observability board, tag label:postmortem-fix and add acceptance criteria (alerts stable 72h, reconcile green 3 nights).

raj: created OBS-1801: "pin sampler + admission check + spans_lost_rate metric". will add grafana panel and low-sev pager.

emily: created OBS-1802: "aggregation invariants + nightly reconcile + canary". added test vectors covering TTL edge cases.

vincent: created OBS-1803: "ETL consumer tuning + rebalance experiment + backfill playbook". mitigation step applied.

marta: add an automated weekly audit that looks for config drift, duplicate counts, and midnight backlog. if audit fails twice, escalate to platform oncall.

emily: adding synthetic trace generator to PR checks to detect aggregation drift. snippet in ticket.

raj: adding spans_lost_rate alert to OBS-1801 now. will paste query when done.

oncall-bot: deploy started by vincent at 2423457000. Command: ```kubectl -n analytics rollout restart deploy etl-consumer```

marta: thanks all. short check-in tomorrow 10:00 PT. update tickets by EOD today; escalate blockers here.
